reference_mode: llama-server /apply-template (OpenAI chat body: messages, optional tools, add_generation_prompt). The reference strips a template-emitted leading BOS from the rendered text when the model's add_bos_token policy is true (llama.cpp re-adds it at tokenization), so expected_prompt has no leading bos_token; the parity tests add it back when comparing the adapter render, which binds the model BOS into the template context. Cases the reference refuses with 400 (e.g. add_generation_prompt=true on a conversation ending in an assistant tool-call message) record a reference_refusal instead of a prompt. date_string is pinned from the reference capture clock.
